name: Media Canonical Download
description: Serves a media entity's file directly from the media's canonical route (respecting media view access).
project_description:
The Media Canonical Download Module provides an option to download a file directly when a media entity is viewed.

 

 Usage:

 
 Install the Media Canonical Download module. 
 Select “Standalone Media URLs” at /admin/config/media/media-settings 
 Create (or edit) a document media type.
 
 Make sure to check “Create new revision”. 
 
 Check “Serve file directly” from the Media Canonical Download settings. 
 
 Visiting the media canonical route (eg. /media/1) will then download the file directly instead of showing the media entity page.
